mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO FAVORITES (USER_ID, LISTING_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{listingId})
mapper.select: SELECT L.LISTING_ID, L.TITLE, L.ROOM_TYPE, L.DEAL_TYPE, L.DEPOSIT, L.MONTHLY_RENT, L.ADDRESS_ROAD, L.AREA_M2, LI.S3_URL AS THUMBNAIL_URL, L.STATUS, F.CREATED_AT AS FAVORITED_AT FROM FAVORITES F INNER JOIN LISTINGS L ON L.LISTING_ID = F.LISTING_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LISTING_ID, S3_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LISTING_ID ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, LISTING_IMAGE_ID ASC) AS RN FROM LISTING_IMAGES ) LI ON LI.LISTING_ID = L.LISTING_ID AND LI.RN = 1 WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITES F INNER JOIN LISTINGS L ON L.LISTING_ID = F.LISTING_ID WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.DELETED_AT IS NULL
